body.zh-Hant: 卡爾·斯塔夫1860年1月21日生於斯德哥爾摩的克拉拉教區。他早年從事法律工作，1893至1900年在斯德哥爾摩自設律師事務所，偏愛承辦刑事案件，也常自費替較貧困的當事人辯護。
body.en: Karl Staaff was born on 21 January 1860 in Klara parish, Stockholm. He worked in the law; from 1893 to 1900 he ran his own law office in Stockholm, preferred criminal cases, and at times represented poorer clients at his own expense.

heading.zh-Hant: 進入國會與自由派組織
heading.en: Into the Riksdag and Liberal organisation

body.zh-Hant: 斯塔夫自1890年代後期起是瑞典國會下院議員（SBL記自1897年，NE記自1896年）。1900年下院成立自由派聯合黨；1902年自由派全國聯盟成立，他進入其信任委員會，1902至1906年任副主席。
body.en: From the late 1890s Staaff sat in the lower house of the Riksdag (SBL gives 1897, NE gives 1896). The Liberal Coalition Party was formed in that house in 1900; when the Liberal national association was founded in 1902 he joined its council and was its vice-chairman from 1902 to 1906.

heading.en: The 1905 union dissolution and first premiership

body.zh-Hant: 1905年8月2日他以諮詢性閣員身分入閣，並被派往卡爾斯塔德，為和平解散瑞典與挪威的聯盟而談判。同年11月7日他出任首相兼司法部門首長；他要求解散下院，遭國王拒絕後，內閣不到七個月便於1906年5月29日辭職。
body.en: On 2 August 1905 Staaff entered the cabinet as a consultative member and was sent to Karlstad to negotiate the dissolution of the union between Sweden and Norway. On 7 November 1905 he became prime minister and head of the justice department; after the king refused his demand to dissolve the lower house, the government resigned on 29 May 1906, in under seven months.

body.zh-Hant: 1907年起他任自由派聯合黨信任委員會主席，丹麥Lex亦稱他自1907年起是該黨主席。1908至1912年他是自由派全國聯盟執行委員會成員，1909至1910年任下院副議長。在他領導下，新黨綱把議會制列為第一項。
body.en: From 1907 Staaff chaired the council of the Liberal Coalition Party, and the Danish Lex likewise says he was its chairman from 1907. From 1908 to 1912 he sat on the executive committee of the Liberal national association, and in 1909-1910 he was vice-speaker of the lower house. Under his leadership a new party programme put parliamentarism first.

heading.zh-Hant: 第二次內閣與王宮庭院危機
heading.en: Second government and the courtyard crisis

body.zh-Hant: 1911年10月7日他再度出任首相，至1914年2月17日。新內閣的兩位國防大臣都由文人擔任，政府並推遲備受爭議的裝甲艦工程。1914年2月6日農民在王宮庭院集會，國王表示政府反對他屬意的國防方案，內閣隨後辭職。
body.en: He became prime minister again on 7 October 1911 and served until 17 February 1914. Both new ministers for defence were civilians, and the government postponed the much-debated armoured-ship project. At the farmers' march into the palace courtyard on 6 February 1914 the king named the government as opposing the defence solution he wanted, and the government then resigned.

body.zh-Hant: 辭職後他仍在下院，並主持1914年夏季的國防委員會談判；世界大戰爆發後，他與布蘭廷通知首相可獲多數支持其國防案。1915年夏天主張瑞典積極參戰的聲浪升高，他發起反對「活動主義」、支持和平的運動，之後因咽喉感染併發肺炎與敗血症，於10月4日去世。SBL稱他被評為瑞典第一位現代政治領袖。
body.en: After resigning he remained in the lower house and chaired the summer 1914 committee negotiations on defence; once the world war had broken out, he and Branting told the head of government that he could count on a majority for his defence proposal. In summer 1915 agitation for active Swedish participation grew; he began a campaign against "activism" and for peace, then died on 4 October after a throat infection developed into pneumonia and fatal blood poisoning. The SBL says he has been characterised as Sweden's first modern political leader.

body.zh-Hant: 埃米利奧·波特斯·希爾生於墨西哥塔毛利帕斯州的維多利亞城（各來源記載的出生年份不一）。1914年底他仍是學生時加入革命運動，1915年任軍法部門副主管與主管，同年10月取得自由法學院的律師資格。
body.en: Emilio Portes Gil was born in Ciudad Victoria, Tamaulipas (sources differ on the year of birth). In late 1914, still a student, he joined the revolutionary movement; in 1915 he served as deputy head and then head of the Department of Military Justice, and in October 1915 he received his law degree from the Escuela Libre de Derecho.

heading.zh-Hant: 議員與塔毛利帕斯州長

body.zh-Hant: 1917年他當選聯邦眾議員（第二十七屆國會），之後還在第二十九至三十一屆國會任職。他曾任塔毛利帕斯臨時州長四個月；1924年10月當選州長，任期三年半，之後辭職轉任內政部長。
body.en: In 1917 he was elected a federal deputy to the XXVII Legislature and later also served in the XXIX, XXX and XXXI Legislatures. He was provisional governor of Tamaulipas for four months; in October 1924 he was elected governor for a term of three and a half years, then resigned to accept the Secretariat of the Interior.

heading.en: Interior minister and the congressional choice

body.zh-Hant: 總統當選人奧夫雷貢1928年7月17日遇刺。波特斯·希爾在8月28日至11月30日任內政部長期間，被國會指定暫時接任最高行政職位。
body.en: President-elect Álvaro Obregón was assassinated on 17 July 1928. While Portes Gil was Secretary of the Interior, from 28 August to 30 November 1928, Congress designated him to take over the presidency provisionally.

citations.quote: Álvaro Obregón, había sido asesinado el 17 de julio de 1928
del 28 de agosto al 30 de noviembre de 1928
fue designado por el Congreso para asumir la Primera Magistratura
was selected by Congress to serve as interim president

body.zh-Hant: 他擔任臨時總統約14個月（1928至1930年）。任內頒布聯邦勞動法與刑法，國立大學獲得自治；他給予桑地諾政治庇護、與蘇聯斷交，並與大主教談判結束基督戰爭。1929年3月4日國民革命黨成立，大會在克雷塔羅舉行。
body.en: He served as interim president for 14 months (1928-1930). During his term the Federal Labour Code and the Penal Code were promulgated and the National University gained autonomy; he granted political asylum to Sandino, broke relations with the USSR, and negotiated with the archbishops the end of the Cristero War. The National Revolutionary Party was constituted on 4 March 1929, with its convention held in Querétaro.

heading.zh-Hant: 黨主席、外交職務與總檢察長
heading.en: Party president, diplomatic posts and attorney general

body.zh-Hant: 1930年他首度出任國民革命黨主席。1931年7月1日起他任駐法國公使，同年9月14日獲任國際聯盟的正式代表。1932年9月6日至1934年11月30日他任聯邦總檢察長。
body.en: In 1930 he first became president of the National Revolutionary Party. From 1 July 1931 he was Mexico's envoy extraordinary and minister plenipotentiary to France, and on 14 September 1931 he was appointed a titular delegate to the League of Nations. From 6 September 1932 to 30 November 1934 he was Attorney General of the Republic.

body.zh-Hant: 卡德納斯1934年12月1日就職當天，波特斯·希爾出任外交部長；他1935年6月15日因受任國民革命黨執行委員會主席而辭職，主席任期至1936年。1951年8月16日起他任墨西哥駐印度首任大使，一年後因健康辭職。他於1978年12月10日在墨西哥城逝世。
body.en: On 1 December 1934, the day Cárdenas took office, Portes Gil became Secretary of Foreign Relations; he resigned on 15 June 1935 on being designated president of the Executive Committee of the National Revolutionary Party, a presidency that ran to 1936. From 16 August 1951 he was Mexico's first ambassador to India and resigned a year later for reasons of health. He died in Mexico City on 10 December 1978.

people.name: Pavlos Kountouriotis
people.nameZh: 帕夫洛斯·孔杜里奧蒂斯

body.zh-Hant: 保羅·孔杜里奧蒂斯生於伊德拉島，1874年加入皇家海軍。1908年他成為國王喬治一世的侍從武官，次年升任上校；1911年6月他出任新艦「阿維羅夫」號的艦長。
body.en: Pavlos Kountouriotis was born on Hydra and joined the Royal Navy in 1874. In 1908 he became aide-de-camp to King George I and was promoted to captain the following year; in June 1911 he took command of the newly built battleship Georgios Averof.

heading.zh-Hant: 巴爾幹戰爭中的艦隊司令
heading.en: Fleet commander in the Balkan Wars

body.zh-Hant: 1912年10月5日巴爾幹戰爭爆發之際，他晉升少將，並成為愛琴海艦隊司令。他先佔領利姆諾斯，再取得周邊島嶼；12月3日的埃利海戰與1913年1月5日的利姆諾斯海戰後，希臘取得愛琴海的完全控制。戰爭結束後他晉升中將。
body.en: On 5 October 1912, as the Balkan Wars broke out, he was promoted to rear admiral and became commander of the Aegean fleet. He first took Lemnos and then other islands; after the battles of Elli on 3 December 1912 and of Lemnos on 5 January 1913 Greece gained full control of the Aegean. At the end of the wars he was promoted to vice admiral.

heading.zh-Hant: 海軍部長與塞薩洛尼基革命政府
heading.en: Navy minister and the Thessaloniki government

body.zh-Hant: 1915年10月25日他退役後出任海軍部長。1916年9月他加入國防運動並前往塞薩洛尼基，成為革命政府三人執政團的成員，同行者是道格里斯將軍與韋尼澤洛斯。1917年6月國王君士坦丁被逐後他回到雅典，再任海軍部長，1919年12月2日表示退出現役政治。
body.en: On 25 October 1915 he retired from active service and took the Ministry of the Navy. In September 1916 he joined the National Defence movement and went to Thessaloniki, where he sat as a member of the triumvirate of the revolutionary government with General Danglis and Eleftherios Venizelos. In June 1917, after King Constantine was expelled, he returned to Athens and again took the navy portfolio; on 2 December 1919 he announced his withdrawal from active politics.

citations.evidenceNote: 前文：他留在政府，直到該日宣布退出積極政治

body.zh-Hant: 1920年10月12日亞歷山大國王猝死後，議會請他出任攝政，至同年11月。官方頁另記，君士坦丁國王去小亞細亞後他自1921年春至1922年春再度攝政。1923年12月喬治二世離境後他又被請出任攝政，至1924年3月。
body.en: After King Alexander's sudden death on 12 October 1920, the parliament called on him to act as regent until November 1920. The official page also records a further regency from spring 1921 to spring 1922, after King Constantine left for Asia Minor. After King George II left the country in December 1923, he was called on once more to act as regent until March 1924.

citations.quote: Μετά τον αιφνίδιο θάνατο του βασιλιά Αλέξανδρου στις 12 Οκτωβρίου 1920

(την άνοιξη του 1921 μέχρι την άνοιξη του 1922)

body.zh-Hant: 1924年3月國民議會宣布共和，委託他暫時掌握最高職位，他實際上成為希臘共和國第一任總統。1925年6月潘加洛斯將軍推翻政府，次年1月他又解散議會建立獨裁；孔杜里奧蒂斯在抗議中辭職，專章記他留任至1926年3月15日。
body.en: In March 1924 the National Assembly proclaimed the republic and entrusted him with provisionally holding its highest office, and he effectively became the first President of the Hellenic Republic. In June 1925 General Pangalos overthrew the government and in January 1926 dissolved parliament to set up a dictatorship; Kountouriotis resigned in protest, and the chapter records that he stayed in post until 15 March 1926.

citations.evidenceNote: 原文雙欄版面，「παρέμει-」接「νε」；已依閱讀序合併

body.zh-Hant: 孔杜里奧蒂斯在潘加洛斯獨裁後重回總統職位，GND記他1926至1929年再任國家元首。專章記他1929年6月3日被選為正式總統，同年12月10日辭職。他於1935年8月逝世於帕萊奧法利羅（官方頁記22日，GND與專章記24日）。
body.en: Kountouriotis returned to the presidency after the Pangalos dictatorship, and the GND gives him a second term as head of state in 1926-1929. The chapter records that he was elected regular president on 3 June 1929 and that he resigned on 10 December 1929. He died in August 1935 at Palaio Faliro (the official page says the 22nd; the GND and the chapter say the 24th).
